people.line: Major Canaanite city conquered by Joshua

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: But as for the cities that stood on their mounds, Israel burned none of them, except Hazor only. Joshua burned that.
translations.bsb: Yet Israel did not burn any of the cities built on their mounds, except Hazor, which Joshua burned.
translations.kjv: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.
translations.asv: But as for the cities that stood on their mounds, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.
